#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string dna;
    std::cin >> dna;
    
    if (dna.empty()) {
        std::cout << 0 << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    int answer = 0;
    int temp = 1;
    char previous = dna[0];
    
    for (size_t i = 1; i < dna.length(); ++i) {
        char current = dna[i];

                ++answer;
                temp = 1;
            }
        } else {
            previous = current;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << answer << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
